title: LOUD Agency CRM
tagline: Client work, meetings, invoicing and UK VAT for a personal branding agency, in one workspace.
description: A demo CRM and business-ops workspace for a London personal branding agency: client health, meetings with AI research, content and visibility pipelines, invoicing and UK VAT returns.
longDescription:
A demo workspace for a fictional London agency that builds the personal brands of C-suite and director-level executives. It covers both sides of the business: the client work and the back office.

- **Dashboard:** MRR, outstanding invoices, audience and engagement KPIs, a client health score and a needs-attention list.
- **Clients and Results:** a page per client with meetings, work log and billing, plus growth since they joined and a printable results report.
- **Meetings:** booking with clash checks and `.ics` invites, notes and actions, and Claude web search + Firecrawl research run straight from the notes.
- **Content and Visibility:** a content calendar, and a pipeline for speaking, podcast, media and award opportunities.
- **Invoices:** drafts built from logged work, founder approval, sequential numbering, reminders and credit notes, with printable UK VAT invoices.
- **Finance:** nine-box VAT returns on invoice or cash basis with pre-filing checks, aged debtors, P&L, a corporation tax estimate, and CSV and Xero exports.

It runs on a small Node server that reads and writes JSON files, so the whole dataset is versionable. Without API keys the seeded research briefs still work. The live demo is a browser-only copy that runs from a data snapshot, with its own 11-step guided tour and no API calls.

> All clients, companies, staff and figures are fictional.
